verdict.rationale: Digits is an AI-native accounting SaaS that processes customer financial data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The pack documents no setting, policy or contractual commitment that keeps user data out of model training. The security evidence covers encryption, which is a different control, and the AGL page says its models are trained on 170M+ transactions without describing any opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
